choix.detail: I write the project and your roadmap.

roadmap.voici_aide: I built it from your answers: milestones, tasks, estimates. Each finished milestone unlocks an achievement and levels up the studio.
roadmap.attente: I'm writing your roadmap from your answers…
roadmap.attente_longue: Still writing: a full roadmap deserves some care.
roadmap.attente_bloquee: Nothing for 5 minutes. If the Claude session closed, reopen it and say "resume my studio": it will write the roadmap from your answers, which are saved.
roadmap.relancer: Remind it to write the roadmap
roadmap.relance_texte: The questionnaire is approved: write the roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md and .studio/roadmap.json) from .studio/reponses_questionnaire.json.
